search.placeholder: a decision, a trap, a rule
search.cappedAt: first {{count}} — more match, so narrow it
search.emptyLexical: Lexical search matches words, so a repository that reached the same conclusion in different vocabulary will not appear here. Convergence finds those.
search.emptySemantic: Search here matches meaning as well as words, so nothing the family learned is close to this. Convergence shows where two repositories reached one conclusion.
search.nothingBody: Neither search could read the index this time, so this is not an empty answer. Try again, or rebuild the index.
search.meaningDown: Matched on words only: the search by meaning did not answer this time, so a conclusion reached in other words may be missing.
search.none.headline: Choose a result
search.none.body: What has the family already learned about it — decisions, fixes, rules, outcomes, across every repository. Search in the list, and the entry a result names is read here, as it is written.
search.gone.headline: This entry is no longer in the index
search.gone.body: It was moved, renamed or deleted since it was found, or its repository was retired. Search again in the list.
